title: Some quadratically closed fields of nimbers
summary: In 1976, J. H. Conway introduced Nim arithmetic which establishes an algebraically closed field structure over the class of ordinals and proved that the first transcendental ordinal is $ω^{ω^ω}$. The problem of finding the next transcendental ordinal is still open. Two years later, H. Lenstra proved that $\varepsilon_0$ is the next quadratically closed field ordinal. In this paper, we prove that $\{\varepsilon_α\mid α\leq ω^{ω^ω} \}$ are the next quadratically closed field ordinals.
